_comment: Documented intentional divergences subtracted from the Layer 0 diff buckets. `exports.missing` keys are upstream symbols knowingly absent from PSFlow's surface; `exports.extra` keys are PSFlow-only names that are intentional renames/idioms. Each value is the rationale shown in report.md. Genuine-but-tracked gaps reference a ticket. A NEW upstream symbol not listed here trips the parity gate.
_comment_props: `props.<Type>` accepts four keys, all optional. `rename` maps an upstream member name to the PSFlow name standing in for it and is applied to the upstream set before diffing, so one entry cancels the divergence on both sides instead of leaving a missing row and an extra row that can drift apart. `missing` and `extra` are rationale maps in the same shape as `exports.*`, consumed by the same partition(). `drift` is report annotation only — it labels a member in the output and suppresses nothing. Prop divergence gates CI as of ticket 071: anything not declared here fails `npm run parity:api`. Note the comparison is name-only; see the limit documented in report.md.

missing.NodeAddChange: Constructor of the PS `NodeChange` sum type, reachable via `NodeChange(..)`. TS exports each change as a standalone type; PS models them as one sum type (intentional).
missing.NodeRemoveChange: Constructor of the PS `NodeChange` sum type, reachable via `NodeChange(..)`.

missing.EdgeRemoveChange: Constructor of the PS `EdgeChange` sum type, reachable via `EdgeChange(..)`.
missing.EdgeReplaceChange: Constructor of the PS `EdgeChange` sum type, reachable via `EdgeChange(..)`.
missing.EdgeSelectionChange: Constructor of the PS `EdgeChange` sum type, reachable via `EdgeChange(..)`.
missing.GetBezierPathParams: PS `BezierPathParams` (System.Utils.Edges.Bezier); `Get` prefix dropped, not re-exported via the React barrel — ticket 058.
missing.NoConnection: Nullary constructor of PS `ConnectionState`, not a standalone type — documented in src/React.purs header & ticket 054.
missing.NodeProps: Record exists in src/React/Types/Nodes.purs but is not re-exported via the React barrel (EdgeProps is) — ticket 058.
missing.NodeHandle: Defined in src/System/Types/Node.purs; not surfaced — ticket 058.
missing.MiniMapNode: Component exists (src/React/Additional/MiniMap/Node.purs); not in the public barrel — ticket 058.
missing.MiniMapNodes: Component exists (src/React/Additional/MiniMap.purs); not in the public barrel — ticket 058.
missing.MiniMapNodeProps: Defined in src/React/Types/Component.purs; not surfaced — ticket 058.
missing.FitViewParams: Defined in src/System/Utils/Graph.purs; not surfaced — ticket 058.
missing.UseNodeConnectionsParams: Defined in src/React/Hook/NodeConnections.purs; not surfaced — ticket 058.
missing.ConnectionLineComponent: Upstream connection-line component type; PS surfaces ConnectionLineComponentProps but not the component-type alias — ticket 058.
missing.EdgeComponentWithPathOptions: Upstream-only edge component type; not modelled in PSFlow — ticket 058.
missing.BuiltInEdge: Upstream union of built-in edge variants; not modelled as a named export — ticket 058.
missing.BuiltInNode: Upstream union of built-in node variants; not modelled as a named export — ticket 058.
missing.GetMiniMapNodeAttribute: Upstream MiniMap internal accessor type; not modelled — ticket 058.
missing.ResizeControlProps: Upstream NodeResizeControl prop type; not modelled as a named export — ticket 058.
missing.ResizeControlLineProps: Upstream NodeResizeControl line-variant prop type; not modelled — ticket 058.

extra.children: React children are an explicit record field in PureScript rather than an implicit JSX slot; upstream gets them from React.PropsWithChildren, which the TS extractor does not attribute to the xyflow sources.
extra.onScroll: Inherited by upstream from HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, which the extractor excludes on both sides by design; PSFlow must declare it explicitly to expose it at all.

drift.positionAbsoluteX: closed by ticket 069 — the xPos/yPos rename is fully ported; retained as a pointer to the upstream 12.3.5 name
drift.positionAbsoluteY: closed by ticket 069 — the xPos/yPos rename is fully ported; retained as a pointer to the upstream 12.3.5 name
